name: NIST SP 800-171 Rev 3
description: Protecting Controlled Unclassified Information in Nonfederal Systems and Organizations, Revision 3 (May 2024). 17 families, 97 security requirements with organization-defined parameters, assessed with the determination statements of NIST SP 800-171A Rev 3.

name: NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2
description: Protecting Controlled Unclassified Information in Nonfederal Systems and Organizations, Revision 2 (February 2020, updated January 2021). 14 families, 110 security requirements, 320 assessment objectives from NIST SP 800-171A. This is the baseline assessed under CMMC Level 2.
